complaint_text: The cellular network tower on North Ridge was struck by lightning and physically damaged; the entire area has zero service.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: Direct lightning surge damaged RF transceiver unit and burned tower top amplifier jumper coaxial cable.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Emergency Field Deployment: Dispatched high-altitude tower rigging crew. Replaced damaged RF unit, re-spliced coaxial jumpers, and restored sector transmission.

recommendations.immediate_action: Deploy mobile cellular COW (Cell-On-Wheels) unit to provide temporary coverage within 2 hours while tower riggers repair hardware.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Upgrade tower lightning arrestors to 200kA surge suppression and install heavy-duty grounding rings at tower base.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Issue automatic proactive bill credit for 1 full billing cycle to all subscribers in the affected sector cell grid.

company_recommendations: 1. Immediate Field Deployment: Dispatch emergency high-altitude rigging crew and position a mobile Cell-on-Wheels (COW) to restore minimum 4G voice/data coverage within 2 hours.
2. Infrastructure Hardening: Retrofit tower grounding systems with 200kA surge suppression arrestors to prevent repeat electrical surge damage during storm seasons.
3. Automated SLA Relief: Trigger automated 1-month subscription fee credit across all 4,200 impacted accounts in the affected sector grid to minimize churn.
4. Proactive Multi-Channel Broadcast: Push geo-targeted SMS updates every 2 hours with real-time restoration milestones to reduce inbound contact center load by 70%.

complaint_text: Commercial broadband down; construction excavator severed underground fiber optic cable trunk line.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: Third-party trenching contractor breached unmarked 144-strand optical fiber conduit.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Emergency optical field engineering team deployed with fusion splicers; pulled 60 meters of new 144-core armored fiber and re-spliced all optical paths.

recommendations.immediate_action: Reroute high-priority BGP traffic through redundant secondary ring path to restore critical commercial circuits immediately.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Install RFID electronic marker balls and steel armor encasement along municipal road construction corridors.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Activate SLA emergency relief rebate for all commercial enterprise accounts affected.

company_recommendations: 1. Dynamic Optical Rerouting: Execute automated BGP ring failover through secondary redundant dark fiber paths to restore critical enterprise circuits within 15 minutes.
2. Fusion Splicing Mobilization: Deploy dual optical splicing teams simultaneously from North and South conduit endpoints to accelerate 144-core splicing by 50%.
3. Municipal Corridor Protection: Embed 3M RFID marker balls and steel-reinforced conduit shielding along high-risk civil construction zones.
4. Enterprise Account Concierge: Assign dedicated enterprise account managers to high-value commercial accounts with proactive hourly MTTR reports and contract SLA penalty waivers.

complaint_text: Subscriber home optical router has been completely unresponsive and red power light blinking for 4 days.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: Internal capacitor degradation on router power supply unit causing boot loop.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Priority tier-2 technician dispatch provided and installed upgraded Wi-Fi 6 Gateway router on-site and verified 500Mbps optical sync.

recommendations.immediate_action: Dispatch technician with pre-provisioned replacement router and waiver of dispatch service fees.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Run automated remote TR-069 device health telemetry scans to detect repeating router reboot loops before customer calls.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Issue $30 goodwill account credit and free 3-month speed tier upgrade.

company_recommendations: 1. Same-Day Hardware Swap: Dispatch field technician with pre-provisioned Wi-Fi 6 Gateway router within 4 hours, waiving all dispatch fees.
2. Automatic Escalation Check: If router remains unresolved at day 7, automatically move ticket to CRITICAL with executive customer retention team assignment.
3. Remote TR-069 Telemetry: Implement real-time heartbeat monitoring on subscriber ONTs to detect hardware boot loops before customers report service outages.
4. Goodwill Retention Package: Credit 50% of the monthly bill and provide complimentary 300Mbps to 500Mbps tier boost for 90 days.

complaint_text: Emergency 911 dispatch lines and priority public safety circuits are unreachable in our healthcare clinic.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: SIP trunk authentication certificate expired on local Session Border Controller (SBC).
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Instant emergency NOC failover switched public safety PRI circuits to redundant cellular gateway, and renewed SBC TLS certificates within 25 minutes.

recommendations.immediate_action: Engage Tier-3 Public Safety Incident Manager and failover immediately to secondary LTE backup trunk.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Implement automated 60-day advance certificate renewal alerts and weekly health ping tests on all 911/PSAP interfaces.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Deliver formal Incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) report to facility safety board within 24 hours.

company_recommendations: 1. Immediate Life-Safety Failover: Trigger instant automated PRI failover to secondary LTE/5G wireless backup gateway to maintain 100% 911 circuit uptime.
2. Automated Certificate Lifecycles: Deploy automated ACME certificate management on all Session Border Controllers with 60-day renewal warnings and redundant auth tokens.
3. 24/7 Priority Public Safety Queue: Establish a zero-wait routing queue in the NOC dedicated exclusively to municipal emergency services and healthcare infrastructure.
4. Mandatory RCA Deliverable: Deliver a formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to municipal regulators and facility safety leadership within 24 hours.

complaint_text: Internet disconnects every day repeatedly for the past 30 days; unresolved for over 7 days despite multiple calls.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: Corroded coaxial connector at the neighborhood distribution tap causing severe signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) drop during thermal expansion.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Escalated to CRITICAL due to 8 days unresolved status. Senior field line engineer replaced tap port, compression connectors, and full drop cable.

recommendations.immediate_action: Schedule dedicated senior field technician appointment with full RF analyzer testing equipment.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Implement automated proactive PNM (Proactive Network Maintenance) modem telemetry alerts to flag micro-reflections and ingress noise automatically.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Provide 1-month service fee waiver for prolonged chronic disruption.

company_recommendations: 1. 7-Day Threshold Auto-Escalation: As ticket reached 8 days unresolved, trigger mandatory CRITICAL priority escalation with dedicated Senior Field Engineer dispatch.
2. End-to-End Demarcation Replacement: Replace distribution tap port, compression F-connectors, and pole-to-home coaxial drop line to permanently eliminate ingress noise.
3. Proactive Network Telemetry (PNM): Monitor upstream SNR telemetry for 14 days post-repair to verify zero packet drops under thermal variation.
4. Executive Churn Mitigation: Grant 2 months of full billing credit and assign an executive care specialist to conduct follow-up verification calls.

complaint_text: I was billed an extra $45 charge on my monthly broadband bill for international roaming package I never ordered.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: Automated plan rollover script misidentified promotional trial expiration code and applied standard roaming add-on.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Billing operations verified account logs, removed unauthorized roaming add-on, and issued an immediate $45 credit refund to customer account balance.

recommendations.immediate_action: Apply immediate ledger credit adjustment and issue updated PDF statement to customer portal.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Add validation safeguard rule to provisioning engine to require customer OTP confirmation before applying recurring billing add-ons.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Send email and SMS confirmation detailing fee removal and zero remaining balance.

company_recommendations: 1. Immediate Ledger Correction: Reverse the unauthorized $45 surcharge within 2 hours and generate a corrected e-statement on the subscriber portal.
2. Provisioning OTP Gatekeeper: Enforce mandatory two-factor customer authorization before activating recurring international roaming or value-added services.
3. Billing Audit Integrity Check: Run automated nightly reconciliation scripts across promotional expiration queues to prevent systemic overbilling.
4. Customer Trust Assurance: Send instant confirmation SMS and email detailing account credit receipt and reassuring zero impact on credit history.

complaint_text: WiFi coverage is very weak and drops in upstairs master bedroom.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: High 2.4GHz channel interference from neighboring router and physical barrier attenuation across two drywall walls.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Remotely configured auto-channel selection to clean 5GHz DFS band and shipped complimentary mesh Wi-Fi extender pod.

recommendations.immediate_action: Guide subscriber through mobile app Wi-Fi optimizer tool and trigger remote band steering optimization.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Enable AI-driven Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) and intelligent client steering on standard firmware.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Offer free 30-day trial of whole-home mesh Wi-Fi pods.

company_recommendations: 1. Remote Channel Optimization: Trigger remote TR-069 channel scan to migrate connection to clear 5GHz DFS channels with band steering.
2. Mesh Hardware Provisioning: Ship a pre-paired whole-home mesh Wi-Fi extender pod with zero upfront deposit.
3. Mobile Self-Care Diagnostics: Enable in-app AR Wi-Fi heatmapping in the customer mobile app to help users optimize access point placement.
4. NPS Enhancement Follow-Up: Schedule an automated follow-up notification 48 hours post-extender delivery to verify signal coverage.

complaint_text: New replacement 5G SIM card was delivered yesterday but activation OTP has not been received after 24 hours.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: ICCID mismatch between shipping barcode scan and database activation queue.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Support agent re-entered the 19-digit SIM ICCID directly into HSS/HLR provisioning portal and pushed instant Over-The-Air (OTA) network profile.

recommendations.immediate_action: Validate ICCID and IMEI in provisioning tool and send manual network refresh burst.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Implement automated QR-code scanning in the self-care mobile app for instant customer SIM self-activation.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Send immediate welcome notification SMS with confirmation of activated plan.

company_recommendations: 1. Instant HSS Profile Push: Re-validate SIM ICCID/IMSI in the HSS provisioning gateway and transmit an instantaneous OTA activation burst.
2. Mobile Self-Activation Scanner: Launch barcode/QR scanning in the mobile onboarding app to eliminate manual fulfillment data entry errors.
3. Provisioning Queue Telemetry: Establish automated dead-letter queue monitoring to alert provisioning ops when activation exceeds 30 minutes.
4. Welcome Compensation: Provide 5GB complimentary bonus data credit on the activated plan as a service onboarding courtesy.

complaint_text: Download speed drops drastically from 300Mbps to 12Mbps every night between 8 PM and 11 PM for past 2 weeks.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: Neighborhood optical node exceeded 92% capacity during evening streaming peak hours.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Escalated to CRITICAL due to 14 days unresolved neighborhood congestion. Network engineering performed optical node split and reallocated 8 downstream OFDM channels.

recommendations.immediate_action: Apply dynamic QoS traffic prioritization to prioritize real-time interactive traffic and video conferencing.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Implement proactive capacity planning alerts triggered when node utilization exceeds 75% for 3 consecutive days.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Notify neighborhood subscribers of completed node split capacity upgrade.

company_recommendations: 1. 7-Day Overdue Escalation: Because neighborhood congestion persisted for >7 days (14 days), elevate priority to CRITICAL to expedite civil node-splitting works.
2. Optical Node Segmentation: Perform optical node split and allocate additional DOCSIS 3.1 OFDM downstream bandwidth channels to double neighborhood capacity.
3. Dynamic Evening QoS: Configure dynamic traffic scheduling during 8 PM - 11 PM to prioritize low-latency conferencing and streaming packets.
4. Transparent Neighborhood Outreach: Deliver personalized email notifications to all 120 subscribers detailing network expansion milestones and date of completion.

complaint_text: Voice calls drop after 30 seconds inside office building; ongoing for 5 days.

resolution_details.root_cause_found: Low-E glass coating in office building blocked outdoor cellular RF signal; VoWiFi (Wi-Fi Calling) was disabled on device profile.
resolution_details.resolution_action_taken: Enabled VoWiFi on subscriber IMS subscription profile and sent remote configuration profile to smartphone.

recommendations.immediate_action: Enable Wi-Fi Calling (VoWiFi) and configure ePDG gateway routing.
recommendations.preventive_engineering: Deploy localized enterprise indoor small cells or distributed antenna systems (DAS) for high-density office complexes.
recommendations.customer_care_policy: Send step-by-step device guide on enabling Wi-Fi Calling.

company_recommendations: 1. Remote VoWiFi Provisioning: Push automatic Over-the-Air IMS profile update to activate Voice-over-Wi-Fi (VoWiFi) and optimize ePDG tunnel handover.
2. Indoor Coverage Assessment: Offer enterprise building management a complimentary indoor Distributed Antenna System (DAS) or femtocell feasibility survey.
3. Multi-Device Setup Guide: Send interactive SMS guide with visual steps to ensure optimal Wi-Fi Calling device preference settings.
4. Day-7 Escalation Rule: If indoor call drops persist beyond day 7 without resolution, trigger RF field drive-test survey and carrier aggregation tuning.
